# Third-party components

| Component | Source and terms |
| --- | --- |
| ReShade 6.8.0 and its add-on headers | [ReShade v6.8.0](https://github.com/crosire/reshade/tree/v6.8.0), BSD-3-Clause |
| Dear ImGui | [ReShade’s pinned ImGui revision](https://github.com/ocornut/imgui/tree/3912b3d9a9c1b3f17431aebafd86d2f40ee6e59c), MIT |
| nlohmann/json 3.12.0 | [nlohmann/json](https://github.com/nlohmann/json/tree/v3.12.0), MIT |
| Mono.Cecil 0.11.4, .NET Framework build | [Mono.Cecil](https://github.com/jbevain/cecil/tree/0.11.4), MIT |
| minimp3 | [minimp3](https://github.com/lieff/minimp3), CC0-1.0 |
| SweetFX and its AA shaders | [SweetFX](https://github.com/CeeJayDK/SweetFX) and the notices in the shader source |
| Rubber Band 4.0.0 | [Rubber Band licensing](https://breakfastquay.com/rubberband/license.html). The DSP links the vendored GPL-covered source |
| Game Setup Kit 0.8.1 | MIT. The setup package includes the license as `LICENSE`. [Game Setup Kit release and source](https://github.com/goodtripgoodtip/GameSetupKit/releases/tag/v0.8.1) |
| Bandit Infer | [Bandit Infer](https://github.com/openmirlab/bandit-infer), Apache-2.0. The separate [checkpoint](https://zenodo.org/records/12701995) is downloaded by the player |

The soundtrack credits and cue edits are listed in each pack’s CueCredits.tsv. Copyrights and license terms for the source music and game remain with their respective holders.
